title: Chicken 65
description: Spicy deep fried boneless chicken bites marinated in curd and chilli, tempered with curry leaves and green chilli.
steps: Marinate the chicken with the curd, ginger garlic paste, red chilli powder, turmeric powder, garam masala, lemon juice and salt for at least 30 minutes.
Add the cornflour and rice flour to the chicken and mix to coat evenly.
Heat the oil in a kadai on medium-high heat.
Fry the chicken in batches for 5 to 6 minutes until golden and cooked through, then drain on paper.
Fry the green chilli and curry leaves in the same oil for 10 seconds until crisp.
Toss the chicken with the fried chilli and curry leaves and serve hot.
